stories.title: Pioneer Urban to invest Rs 35 bn in Gurugram
stories.summary: Realty firm Pioneer Urban Land and Infrastructure will invest Rs 35 bn to develop an ultra-luxury housing project in Gurugram. The investment is part of the company's expansion strategy. The project aims to capture the high-end segment of the local market.

stories.title: NLMC to auction HIL land in Delhi for Rs 8.3 bn
stories.summary: The National Land Monetisation Corporation has initiated an auction for a 5.119-acre land parcel owned by HIL in New Delhi, with a reserve price of Rs 8.3 bn. The sale is intended to promote productive use of surplus assets. It is the third such auction recently.

stories.title: Uttar Pradesh expands smart cities mission
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is scaling up technology-led urban development across state cities to improve infrastructure, civic services, and sustainability. The government cites planned development and technology-enabled governance as key priorities for the state's growth journey. The mission aims to reshape the urban landscape through these integrated digital initiatives.

stories.title: Jewar airport to anchor new economic hub
stories.summary: The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority plans an integrated ecosystem of aviation, logistics, and residential facilities around the Noida International Airport. The project envisions an aerotropolis to influence regional development. The airport is expected to serve as a gateway for the National Capital Region.

stories.title: Godrej Housing Finance targets Rs 10,000 crore loan book
stories.summary: Godrej Housing Finance plans to scale its affordable housing assets to Rs 10,000 crore by 2031. The lender currently manages Rs 600 crore across 52 branches. It is betting on demand in smaller cities as affordable housing opportunities in major metros continue to shrink.

stories.title: Kochi Metro Pink Line to feature dual-sided access
stories.summary: Construction on the 11.20-km Kakkanad extension is set to accelerate to meet an August 2027 deadline. Officials confirm 10 of the 11 stations will feature entry and exit points on both sides of the road. The Smart City terminal station remains the only exception.

stories.title: Bengaluru to digitise TDR system
stories.summary: The Greater Bengaluru Authority and the Bangalore Development Authority will launch a digital platform to track Transferable Development Rights. The system will record property details and monitor certificate transactions. TDR serves as compensation for landowners who surrender property for public projects instead of receiving cash payments.

stories.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar announced initiatives to regularise houses built on BDA-acquired land by offering reduced charges. The plan includes issuing absolute sale deeds to 20,000 site owners and providing incentive sites to farmers. Applications are open until December 17, 2026.

stories.title: Lagos housing program targets 5,000 units
stories.summary: The Federal Government has partnered with private developers to deliver 5,000 housing units in Ibeju-Lekki. The project aims to provide homes across three estates for Nigerians who cannot afford traditional property purchases. The initiative is part of the broader Renewed Hope Housing Programme.

stories.title: Lagos candidates present housing proposals
stories.summary: Governorship candidates for the 2027 election have proposed competing plans to address housing shortages, including pledges to deliver over 100,000 homes. Proposals include expanded mortgage financing and direct government rental provision. The candidates debated their respective approaches to housing affordability on November 8, 2026.

stories.title: Sonu Nigam buys Mumbai apartment for Rs 443 million
stories.summary: Singer Sonu Nigam purchased a 3,055-square-foot apartment in Andheri West for Rs 443 million. The property, located on the 12th floor of a building formerly known as Mannat, includes four parking spaces. The transaction was registered on October 30, 2026.

stories.title: CT REIT reports property revenue hike
stories.summary: CT Real Estate Investment Trust reported property revenue of $161.3 million for the third quarter, a 6.7 percent increase year over year. CEO Kevin Salsberg stated the performance reinforces the value proposition for unitholders. The company continues to surface additional opportunities to create value despite a volatile environment.

stories.title: Detroit retail center hits the market
stories.summary: A 134,585-square-foot retail property at Gateway Marketplace in Detroit is up for sale. The center includes tenants such as Marshalls and Planet Fitness. The nearby Meijer superstore that anchors the site is not included in the sale. No asking price is publicly listed for the property.

stories.title: Bagmane Group plans large Bengaluru business hub
stories.summary: Bagmane Group is developing the Bagmane Sierra Business District in Yelahanka, North Bengaluru. The project, launched in 2023, spans approximately 49.5 acres with a potential development of 10 million square feet. The hub aims to strengthen corporate presence and create new opportunities for employment and infrastructure growth.

stories.title: India office workforce projected to grow
stories.summary: India's office-using workforce is projected to rise from 38 million in 2025 to 48 million by 2030, according to Cushman and Wakefield. The study attributes this growth to the expansion of global capability centres. These centres remain a key driver of office demand as they transition toward higher-value activities.

stories.title: Study finds office design gap in India
stories.summary: A Compass Group India study of 2,000 workers suggests a contradiction in modern offices. Employees associate breaks and social interaction with productivity, yet many workplaces make these activities difficult to practise. Dining and social spaces are becoming part of the experience, even as work schedules limit their use.

stories.title: McCullagh Property Group completes Brisbane office deals
stories.summary: McCullagh Property Group has acquired two Brisbane office properties for a combined $15.75 million. The purchases include an investment near the James Street precinct and an owner-occupier acquisition in the city legal precinct. The firm secured the assets on behalf of a local client and a law firm.

stories.summary: Manhattan leasing reached 37 million square feet year-to-date, putting 2026 on pace for 44 million, according to Colliers data. Finance and law firms are driving the largest deals. Recovery remains concentrated in trophy buildings, with record rents at the top. No major new tower has opened since 2021.

stories.summary: Adani Enterprises has acquired a 100 percent stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited. The company aims for a 500 MW capacity target as it expands its data center industry presence. The project is the seventh building in the center.

stories.summary: Diamond Properties has acquired Shadeland Industrial Park, a 198,000-square-foot industrial portfolio in Indianapolis, from i3 Investors. JLL Capital Markets represented the seller in the transaction. The fully leased business park provides strategic access to the I-465 beltway and major interstate corridors serving the Midwest region.

stories.summary: UK-listed property shares rose 1.8% in October, recovering from losses in September. Activist investors continue to target specific firms, though many companies remain down for the year to date.

stories.title: Datex Property Solutions adds AI connectivity
stories.summary: Datex Property Solutions has launched Datex AI Live, a tool designed to connect real estate portfolio data to applications like ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot. The company describes the product as a breakthrough that allows organizations to leverage existing AI tools while maintaining control over their portfolio information.

stories.title: Estaie named to UAE Future 100 list
stories.summary: Dubai-based AI-native accommodation platform estaie has been named to the UAE Future 100 list. The initiative, led by the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism, recognizes emerging businesses expected to contribute to the country's technology-driven economy. The list includes companies across fintech, renewable energy and property technology.

stories.title: Sunday PropTech enters Kolkata market
stories.summary: Hospitality firm Sunday PropTech Ltd has acquired an 89-room hotel in Kolkata for an undisclosed amount. The six-storey property, located near the international airport, will operate under the company's Clubhouse brand. This acquisition marks the firm's first hotel in the city and its entry into eastern India.

stories.title: Real estate industry weighs AI risks
stories.summary: Industry professionals discussed the integration of artificial intelligence at the 2026 NXT Regulatory Issues Forum. While the technology offers potential for business efficiency, panelists noted significant concerns regarding ethics, accountability and consumer protection. The session examined how these tools are currently reshaping the real estate profession.

stories.title: Tokenized real estate awaits federal clarity
stories.summary: Commercial real estate investors are still waiting for federal digital asset rules to encourage institutional participation. Despite predictions that clarity would bring capital off the sidelines, industry leaders report that uncertainty remains. A proposed federal framework failed a Senate cloture vote in September 2025.

stories.title: Christine Hansen to lead NAR in 2027
stories.summary: Christine E. Hansen will become the 2027 president of the National Association of Realtors on Tuesday. Hansen, who owns a brokerage in Fort Lauderdale, is credited by colleagues for her mentorship. She takes the role as the association navigates ongoing industry changes and internal leadership transitions.

stories.summary: NAR CEO Nykia Wright addressed concerns regarding the association's new learning management system launching December 1. Some local association executives worry the initiative will compete with their own offerings. NAR leadership stated the system is not intended to encroach on the turf of state and local groups.

stories.title: Cement industry faces margin pressure
stories.summary: India's cement industry saw 9% volume growth in the September quarter, according to Jefferies. Despite the demand, rising input costs caused aggregate EBITDA per tonne to decline by ₹125 to around ₹800. Manufacturers are now focused on sustaining price increases to support earnings recovery.

stories.summary: Rebar futures closed at 3,037, down 0.13 percent. While blast furnace mills cut production to manage losses, electric arc furnace mills maintain high output due to cheaper scrap metal. Trading remains lukewarm as the market balances supply constraints against thin profit margins.

stories.title: Banaras Locomotive Works installs solar panels on tracks
stories.summary: Banaras Locomotive Works has installed solar panels between operational railway tracks, a first for Indian Railways. The unit claims the innovation generates 4.5 megawatts of energy, meeting 20 percent of its power requirements. The project is part of a broader plan to reduce conventional energy use.

stories.title: IOI Properties prepares for record Malaysian REIT IPO
stories.summary: IOI Properties Group is set to launch the largest real estate IPO in Malaysian history, aiming to raise over 515 million dollars. The IOIPG Malaysia REIT is scheduled to list on the Bursa Malaysia exchange on November 25. Maybank Investment Bank is the lead advisor.

stories.title: Car dealership mogul sells Palm Beach compound
stories.summary: A car dealership mogul has sold a Palm Beach compound for nearly $100 million. The full details of the transaction are available to subscribers of the Wall Street Journal. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Spear Street sells Chicago office tower for $115 million
stories.summary: Spear Street Capital sold a 31-story Chicago riverfront office tower for $115 million to Hines and Prime Finance. The sale was guided by Cushman and Wakefield. The full details of the transaction are available to subscribers of Law360.

stories.title: PREP Property Group acquires Casa Grande shopping center
stories.summary: PREP Property Group acquired the 480,000-square-foot Promenade at Casa Grande in Arizona. The company describes itself as an operator-led firm focused on creating value through strategic acquisitions. The center is located at the intersection of Interstate 10 and Florence Boulevard in the Phoenix-Tucson corridor.

stories.title: Blackstone real estate sees senior leadership departures
stories.summary: Nearly a third of senior managing directors for Blackstone's real estate business have left over the past three years. The Wall Street Journal reports that poor fund performance has reduced executive income. Industry executives do not see prospects for the commercial real estate market changing anytime soon.

stories.title: Blackstone real estate executive turnover continues
stories.summary: Nearly a third of Blackstone's senior managing directors have departed over three years, including global head Nadeem Meghji. While senior executives earn roughly $2 million in salary, carried interest has declined. One 2019 fund has returned 3 percent through September. The bonus pool is shrinking.

stories.title: Blackstone appoints new leadership for real estate unit
stories.summary: David Levine and Giovanni Cutaia now lead Blackstone real estate following the exit of Nadeem Meghji. The unit's profit is tracking at half its 2022 peak, and a $30 billion fundraise is delayed. Data center demand and AI-driven leasing are expected to provide some relief.

stories.title: Malaga house prices rise 66 percent in five years
stories.summary: Average home prices in Malaga rose from €2,010 to €3,339 per square metre between 2021 and 2026. This 66 percent increase is nearly double the national average for Spain. The data is based on actual property transactions rather than advertised asking prices.

stories.title: Montreal home sales decline in October
stories.summary: Montreal residential property sales fell 18 percent in October compared to the previous year. Despite the decline in volume, the median price for a single-family home rose 1.6 percent to $640,000. Buyers are reportedly adjusting their choices to fit a market where properties remain largely unaffordable.
